AN ACT TO AMEND THE VALUE ADDED TAX ACT, NO. 14 OF 2002
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka as follows :-

1. This Act may be cited as the Value Added Tax(Amendment) Act, No. of 2011 and shall be deemed to havecome into operation on January 1, 2011 unless different datesof operation are specified in the relevant sections.
